_about: Hand-set TMDB matches, keyed by venue id (or "*" for every venue) then the title exactly as the venue lists it. "tmdb_id": a TMDB movie id sets the match; null keeps the listing unmatched. Optional "note". A venue's entry wins over "*". The run's TMDB report (python -m kinolocator summary --tmdb) lists every unmatched title with why. Validated before every run and by the tests; see kinolocator/tmdb_overrides.py.

Atonement.note: the 2026 short, not Joe Wright's 2007 film
